news.title: Uttar Pradesh rental agreements see a five-time fee cut
news.para: The Uttar Pradesh cabinet has slashed stamp duty and registration fees for rental agreements, striving to bring rates in line with other states and promote formal registrations. Lease contracts lasting a year with rents capped at two lakh rupees will now incur a modest fee of two thousand rupees.

news.title: Starbucks to set up GCC in Chennai, hiring to begin in Q1 2027
news.para: Starbucks is set to launch a Global Capability Centre in Chennai, generating 800 high-quality job opportunities. This center will enhance Starbucks' global operational and technological functions, chosen due to Chennai's wealth of tech talent and impressive employee retention. The company aims to broaden its international coffeehouse presence. This investment signals Tamil Nadu's appeal to multinational enterprises.

news.title: Proposed building norm reforms to benefit property owners, simplify approvals: Bihar government
news.para: Bihar's Proposed Building Bye-Laws 2026 seek to simplify construction activities and foster business growth. Under the leadership of Deputy CM Vijay Kumar Chaudhary, the draft was evaluated by a dedicated Group of Ministers. The urban development department aims to offer relief to property owners and improve living standards for all citizens, with practical feedback from stakeholders playing a key role in finalizing these progressive bye-laws.

news.title: Over 4,500 building regularisation applications stuck as portal goes offline in Jharkhand
news.para: Over two months have passed with thousands of applications for unauthorized buildings in Jharkhand still awaiting regularization. The state’s online portal has ceased processing these submissions, leaving applicants uncertain about their futures. Particularly in Ranchi, civic bodies are struggling to address the backlog. Applicants are anxious about potential penalties since their property details are submitted online.

news.title: Chintels India seeks Gurugram administration nod to raze Tower J in Paradiso
news.para: Chintels India has sought permission from the Gurgaon administration to demolish Tower J, deemed unsafe due to structural issues and a tragic collapse in February 2022. An assessment by IIT Delhi revealed that high chloride levels have rendered repairs impossible. Consequently, residents are ordered to vacate the building by January 1, 2027, while the developer awaits approval for the demolition and subsequent redevelopment.

news.title: Bombay HC says ED arrest not warranted, grants bail to former director of Lodha Developers
news.para: The Bombay High Court evaluated an arrest's legality and subsequently granted bail to Rajendra N Lodha, former director of Lodha Developers. Detained by the Enforcement Directorate in February over alleged financial misconduct, Justice Milind Jadhav determined the arrest contravened PMLA regulations. The court stressed the importance of judicial oversight to safeguard against the improper use of arrest authority.

news.title: Residents urge Noida Authortiy to conduct surprise inspections amid rising encroachments
news.para: Noida residents urge the CEO for more surprise field inspections weekly. They seek physical verification before closing encroachment complaints and follow-up checks.  Concerns were raised about Atta Market and several residential sectors experiencing ongoing issues.  The CEO stated enforcement drives are ongoing and vendors will be relocated.  He acknowledged the recurring nature of encroachments but expects improvements soon.

news.title: Puravankara enters Delhi-NCR with 13.44-acre  land parcel in Greater Noida
news.para: Puravankara has entered the Delhi-NCR market through the allotment of a 13.44-acre land parcel in Greater Noida. The project has a saleable potential of about 4.57 million sq ft and an estimated GDV of ₹5,200 crore.

news.title: Supreme court orders sealing of 16,700 unauthorised properties in Meerut
news.para: The Supreme Court has mandated the immediate sealing of 16,726 unauthorized buildings in Meerut. Authorities reported the demolition of 24 properties under earlier orders. As part of a broader initiative, the court has tasked officials with identifying additional unauthorized structures in various zones. Expressing concern about illegal colonies, the court has called for accountability, with a compliance report due before the next hearing on December 9.

news.title: UP-RERA pays ₹73.84 lakh interest to complainants on delayed RC disbursements
news.para: Uttar Pradesh RERA has paid ₹73.84 lakh in interest across around 430 complaints where amounts recovered through recovery certificates remained in bank accounts pending disbursement. The interest has been calculated for the period during which the recovered funds remained with the bank.

news.title: Berger Paints plans expansion to fend off Birla, JSW
news.para: Berger Paints is strengthening its market position against new competitors. The company plans new luxury paint lines and expanding its exclusive outlets. It is also investing in new manufacturing facilities in eastern India. This strategy aims to counter pricing wars and secure market share. The Indian paint sector anticipates growth driven by urbanization and real estate.

news.title: UAE developer Eagle Hills unveils $12 billion project in the Maldives

news.title: Embassy Developments to sell entire Juhu residential tower to Angel One's MD for ₹711 crore
news.para: Embassy Developments has signed an MoU to sell an entire residential tower at Embassy Terazza in Juhu to Dinesh Thakkar, founder, chairman and managing director of Angel One, for about ₹711 crore. The G+7 tower has a RERA carpet area of 63,000 sq ft.

news.title: Luxury real estate boom in Andheri East as JB Nagar seals a ₹10 crore home deal
news.para: Spread across approximately 3.5 acres, Chandak Sarvam offers thoughtfully planned 2, 3 and 4 BHK residences, complemented by landscaped open spaces, lifestyle amenities and recreational zones.

news.title: Gulshan Group, Ourika Estates to invest over ₹750 crore in Ghaziabad, Lucknow housing projects
news.para: Gulshan Group and Ourika Estates have formed a development platform that will invest over ₹750 crore across two residential projects in Ghaziabad and Lucknow. The developments will have a combined built-up area of about 1.5 million sq ft.

news.title: Thirteen PGs, seven scrap shops shut after failing Pune civic body's fire safety checks
news.para: Pune's authorities undertook a comprehensive sweep to assess fire safety and civic compliance, shutting down thirteen paying guest lodges and seven scrap businesses due to inadequate fire protection and missing permits. The city officials are actively sealing unauthorized operations and pursuing legal action against those failing to meet essential safety standards, emphasizing the commitment to uphold public safety measures.

news.title: Goa's property boom hits a realty check
news.para: Goa's real estate market is stabilizing after a significant boom period.  Sales and enquiries for second homes have slowed considerably over the past year.  North Goa experienced a price correction, while smart capital moves to emerging pockets.  Established developers are strengthening their position as buyers seek reliable track records.  South Goa is increasingly recognized for its peaceful coastal living and refined lifestyle.

news.title: Chalet Hotels in advanced talks to buy Six Senses Vana for ₹600 crore
news.para: Chalet Hotels is on the verge of acquiring Six Senses Vana in Dehradun, a luxurious wellness retreat owned by Veer Singh, son of Analjit Singh. Valued at roughly 600 crore rupees, this deal highlights Chalet's commitment to expanding its footprint in the high-end hospitality market while concurrently developing other upscale properties throughout India.

news.title: Bengaluru development body's new fees put property owners on edge
news.para: In Bengaluru, property owners must brace for heightened costs associated with online civic services due to newly implemented software fees. A two hundred rupee fee will be applicable to residential properties, while others will be charged one thousand rupees. Furthermore, there are notable increases in khata conversion and registration fees across all categories of properties. These charges aim to bolster software development and improve infrastructure.

news.title: Developer in Bhopal booked after resident claims hidden pipeline to route sewage overflow
news.para: A colony builder stands accused of illicitly diverting sewage into a borewell, leading to severe groundwater pollution and raising significant health alarms for the local community. In response to numerous complaints, officials promptly inspected the site, sealing the borewell to prevent further contamination. The municipal corporation has issued a formal notice addressing the environmental violations, igniting an ongoing investigation into the sewer disposal practices at hand.
